type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the kind of the issue

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Severity is how serious the issue is

message.description: Message is a human readable explanation of the issue.

ruleName.description: RuleName is the name of the Policy Rule that the issue belongs to, if any.

stepName.description: StepName is the name of the review Step that the issue belongs to, if any.

accessLevel.description: AccessLevel is the name of the Catalog access level that the issue belongs to, if any.

ref.description: Ref is the reference of the object that the issue is about, if any.

ConfigurationIssue.title: Configuration Issue
ConfigurationIssue.description: ConfigurationIssue is a configuration problem that the Cluster detects in an access Policy or in a Catalog

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
